dish: Pommes Soufflés "1949" and seasonal French-European small plates
w: David Falk's flagship in the old Maisonette space — award-winning European cooking with French precision; Cincinnati Magazine's No. 1 Best Restaurant.

dish: short rib cappellacci; house-made pasta
w: Candlelit subterranean Italian below Boca — famed short rib cappellacci and truffle-season tajarin; Cincinnati Magazine No. 3 Best Restaurant.

dish: seasonal New American tasting; hand-cut pasta and crispy chicken
w: Jose Salazar's namesake restaurant, reopened Nov 2025 in the former Saks/Paycor building. Salazar is a 2024 James Beard finalist for Best Chef: Great Lakes.

dish: paella, jamón and ceviche (Spanish and Latin American tapas)
w: Chef Jose Salazar's Spanish/Latin American tapas room named for his Colombian grandmother; Salazar is a James Beard nominee/finalist.

dish: chef-driven tacos and guacamole; modern Mexican
w: David Falk's upscale modern-Mexican room on the Aronoff plaza — reimagined menu and one of downtown's best patios (confirmed open 2025).

dish: bigoli with Nonna's Sunday sauce, veal-and-pork meatballs and braised pork
w: Thunderdome Group's homage to founders' Italian grandparents — pasta made fresh daily; voted Best Italian by CityBeat readers 2025 and a 2026 Yelp Top-100 pick.

dish: the Turtle Shell — a 'hybrid burrito' sealed around a tostada with the famous Gomez salsa
w: OTR walk-up window (in the old Lucy Blue pizza slot) famed for the Turtle Shell and house salsas; a late-night and lunch institution.

dish: pad thai and crispy pork belly with anise glaze
w: Longtime Cincinnati Thai favorite reopened across from Washington Park; voted CityBeat's Best Thai 2025.

dish: Truth IPA (West Coast hops, mango and grapefruit)
w: The brewery that helped launch OTR's beer revival, in the 1890s Christian Moerlein bottling hall; flagship Truth IPA and a rooftop bar. CityBeat's Best Local Brewery.

dish: PsycHOPathy IPA and GABF gold-medal Happy Amber
w: Oakley powerhouse with a 20+ tap taproom, wood-fired pizza and beer garden; repeatedly voted among Cincinnati's best breweries.

dish: Oaxacan tlayudas and tacos (cochinita, birria)
w: Madisonville taqueria steeped in Oaxacan cooking — widely called Cincinnati's best Mexican; from-scratch salsas and moles.

dish: the deluxe cheeseburger, third-pound fresh chuck (recipe since 1926)
w: Mt. Lookout neighborhood tavern, a near-century old; a perennial CityBeat Best Burger and named Ohio's best burger by Food & Wine.

dish: the classic tavern cheeseburger
w: No-frills Norwood grill serving the same cheeseburger since 1966 — the purest expression of the local tavern burger and a repeat Best Cheeseburger winner.

dish: over-the-top build-your-own burger on a filet-mignon grind, dozens of house sauces
w: Neon-drenched East End icon (ex-Terry's Turf Club, on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives) reopened under new local owners Jan 2025, still building maximalist burgers.

dish: shio ramen, sushi and chicken karaage
w: Chef Hideki Harada's izakaya and sushi bar in Clifton's Gaslight district; Harada is a 2023 and 2026 James Beard semifinalist for Best Chef: Great Lakes.

dish: Texas-style chopped brisket and daily-smoked ribs
w: Black-owned Texas-style barbecue that consolidated to its College Hill flagship in 2026; brisket smoked low-and-slow, praised mac and cornbread.

dish: Storm golden cream ale
w: Covington brewery that anchored 7th Street's revival — flagship Storm cream ale and one of NKY's only rooftop taprooms overlooking the river skyline.

dish: seasonal farm-to-table small plates; monthly four-course tastings
w: Stephen Williams's pioneering NKY farm-to-table bistro sourcing 50+ local farms; Cincinnati Magazine Best Restaurants (No. 9) with a 130-bottle bourbon list.

dish: six-course tasting menu built on house sourdough and fresh pasta
w: Dave Willocks's tasting-menu-only Newport flagship — Greater Cincinnati's rarest fine-dining format; Willocks is a 2026 James Beard finalist for Best Chef: Southeast.

dish: single-origin pour-overs and seasonal specialty drinks at the Analog Bar
w: Newport roaster and cafe with a barista 'chef's table' Analog Bar; ranked Kentucky's best independent coffee shop, profits funding coffee-origin philanthropy.
